translations.config.sortKeys: Sort translation keys alphabetically whenever the Lang Editor or the translation commands write a lang file. When off, the existing key order is kept and new keys are placed next to their `en_us` neighbours.
translations.config.autoSave: Save lang files automatically after edits made from the Lang Editor and translation commands (files open in a text editor stay unsaved).
translations.config.untranslatedMarker: Prefix added to English text copied into other locales (e.g. `[TODO] `). Empty: copy the English text as-is; the Lang Editor highlights values identical to `en_us` as untranslated.
translations.config.hover: Show hover previews of `§` formatted strings, JSON text components and the other locales of a key in lang files.
translations.config.colorPicker: Show the colour picker for string colours (`"color": "#RRGGBB"` and named text colours) in resource JSON files.
translations.config.decorations: Decorate `§` colour and formatting codes inside lang files.
